entry.title: Azadi Tower
entry.note: Mapped diagonal four-foot plan aligns the 64 m long dimension nearly north/south and the major arched ±Z facades east/west, as described by the official tourism source. The two-fold exterior symmetry makes a half-turn immaterial. Model fits the published 64 m monument rather than all map outline extremities. The plaza, fountain, ramps and surrounding landscaping are separate scenery. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
